profile.headline: Software Engineer I at GoodRx
profile.summary:
Systems engineer passionate about creating products for the Internet. I have been working on the web for 13 years as a developer and leader of development teams. I have five years of experience as a project manager. I have worked for clients in Colombia, the United States, Mexico, and Central America where I have directed my own projects or for the companies in which I have worked for the health, advertising industry, mass consumption, media, and technological infrastructure, among others.

I am a graduate of Systems Engineering, I have studied physics, project management, product development, and agile methodologies.

Specialties: Agile Methodologies, HTML, JavaScript, REACT, CSS, PHP, Front End Development.
